**Parent / source:** Axel's idea 2026-09-12 — "one image ad per colour variant, white background, just the product". Concept `PD_14` = 18 variants, ONE adset. Isolated variable between the 18: **the colour**.

## 1. Why this ad exists
"18 colours" is one of the product's four selling points, and the signal colours (neon green, orange, yellow) are the reason the visibility angle exists — but no ad on the account shows more than the neon green. A clean product shot per colour lets Meta find which colour buys the click, at image CPM, with zero editor time.

## 2. Hypothesis
Colour is a purchase driver on its own. Ranking the 18 variants on profit contribution tells us which colours to lead with in every later creative (and which to drop from the offer copy).

| Background | Pure white, soft studio light, soft shadow under the boots |

## 5. Three-question test
Every line above passed visualise / falsifiable / only-we-can-say-it in `products/drytrek/batch-03/copy-sonnet.json` (`tre_fragor`). The headline names the exact SKU colour (Brun); the primary text names three fasteners, 44 cm, 18 colours and 389 kr per par — all product facts from `factory/produkter/damasker.yaml`.

## 6. Hard rules for this ad
- **Price:** exactly "389 kr per par" — never another number, never a percentage. Verified in `factory/produkter/damasker.yaml` (`pris: 389`, jämförpris 649) 2026-09-12.
- **Never claim waterproofing** ("vattentät", "vindtät", "stoppar regn", "alla väder"). No time claims. **No social proof** (zero reviews). No urgency, no exclamation marks.
- "14 dagars ångerrätt", "Fri frakt till Sverige och Norge". Never Bäverbutiken or Klarna. Brand is **DryTrek**.
- **No text, price or logo on the image.** The supplier tag on the source photos reads "AYXSEE" — it must NOT appear; the small tag is plain black.
- **No generated people, no faces.** Boots and gaiters only.
- **The colour must match the variant** "Brun" as sold on drytrek.se — a wrong shade sends the buyer to the wrong SKU.
- **Landing page:** https://drytrek.se/products/damasker
- **Naming:** `DryTrek_Damasker_PD_14_12` — never `Damasker_*` without the `DryTrek_` prefix.

## 7. Primary KPI
CTR ≥ 1,5 % and CPA under 243 kr on ≥ 3 purchases. Ranked against the other 17 colours on profit contribution `(243 − CPA) × köp`; the top spender in the adset is the benchmark.

## 8. What we learn regardless of outcome
Which colours sell. Feeds the offer copy ("18 colours" → name the top three) and the next lifestyle batch.
